messages:
zoe: Quick follow-up from the postmortem about the cascading failovers — we need concrete playbook edits and owners. Keep replies short.

max: I can own the playbook rewrite: add a one-line TL;DR, step-by-step triage, and a short checklist for aborting rollouts. ETA Tue 2024-10-15. Owner: @max.

talia: I'll add exact oncall commands and a small diagnostic snippet to collect routing + cache stats. Example:
```
# collect runtime + routing state
redwoodctl status --env prod --service runtime --format=json > /tmp/runtime_status.json
redwoodctl routing list --env prod --route chat-api --out=json | jq .
# capture kv cache snapshot
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9090/debug/kv > /tmp/kv_snapshot.json
```

ben: For escalation, propose: if p99 up by >30% OR error-rate x2 for 10m -> abort rollout, set traffic to fallback, and page SRE lead. I'll own escalation flow + alerts. Due Fri 2024-10-11.

irene: Noted recurring pattern: regressions follow large weight bumps during end-of-day deploy windows. Suggest policy: weight changes >12% require canary + SRE signoff. I'll draft the policy doc. Owner: @irene. Due Mon 2024-10-07.

zoe: Good. Can someone paste a short alert rule for the p99+error combo? We need a Prometheus example for the playbook.

ben: Draft alert (putting inline):
```
- alert: RoutingRolloutHealth
  expr: (increase(requests_total{route="chat-api"}[5m]) > 0) and (histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="chat-api"}[5m])) > 1.3 * avg_over_time(histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="chat-api"}[1h]))[1h]))
  for: 7m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Chat-api p99 spike after routing change"
    runbook: "https://docs.redwood.internal/playbooks/routing-rollout"
```

max: Action items I will open as tickets after this thread:
- RW-INC-5010: playbook rewrite (owner: max) due 2024-10-15
- RW-INC-5011: oncall diagnostics + snippets (owner: talia) due 2024-10-10
- RW-INC-5012: escalation + alert rule (owner: ben) due 2024-10-11
- RW-INC-5013: routing weight policy (owner: irene) due 2024-10-07

reminder-bot: Note: playbook PRs require two approvers (SRE + Routing). I will send reminders 72h before due dates.

talia: I'll include a tiny reproducible payload example in RW-INC-5011 so ML/product can reproduce the request shape that triggers evictions.

irene: I'll add rollout guidance: 0% -> 5% (10m) -> 25% (20m) -> 100%, with validations at each gate and auto-stop on breaches.

max: Reviewers: @ben (SRE) and @irene (routing). I'll tag them on the PR.

ben: I'll draft a short "abort and fallback" command set for oncall:```
# force fallback variant immediately
redwoodctl routing set --route=chat-api --variant=fallback --force --note "emergency fallback by oncall"
# abort current rollout
redwoodctl rollout abort --id $ROLL_ID --reason "auto-abort from playbook"
```

zoe: Great. Also add a 90-day monitoring cadence: weekly checks first 30 days, then monthly for two months. Put that as a checklist item in each ticket.

reminder-bot: Reminders queued. I will ping owners 72h before their due dates and again on PR merge.

max: I'll update the postmortem with owners and ticket links by EOD today. If anything changes, reply here.

talia: PR draft: https://git.internal.redwood.com/r/playbooks/pulls/261 (draft)

irene: LGTM.

ben: Thanks team.

zoe: Closing the loop: I'll publish the updated postmortem with runbook links once PRs are merged. If new info appears, post back here.
